text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a maximum 15-minute pick-up/drop-off area on the east side of Dalhousie Street, north of Dundas Street East, to allow residents to pick-up and drop-off passengers, near No. 135 Dalhousie Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Dalhousie Street, between Dundas Street East and Gould Street, to be in effect from Dundas Street East to a point 9 metres north, and from a point 20 metres north of Dundas Street East to Gould Street. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 15 minutes at all times on the east side of Dalhousie Street, between a point 9 metres north of Dundas Street East and a point 11 metres further north. 3. Rescinded the existing maximum two-hour parking limit in effect at all times on the west side of Dalhousie Street, between a point 70 metres north of Dundas Street East and a point 11 metres further north. 4.
